items.name: Orange - sapling
items.description: This will be an orange tree in 5 stages of it's life.  Please reference the previous stages image if you can.  for the first 4 stages use no fruit. Fruit only on the last stage (fruiting): sapling, small, medium, mature, fruiting . these should be low poly and use the same style from stage to stage (sapling growth stage)
